description: PAID: $2.00 USDC per call on Base (x402), charged only for valid input. Composite payment decision ("can we safely execute this payment today?"). Orchestrates the liquidity, FX exposure, and (optionally) treasury risk capabilities to produce a PAY/REVIEW/DO_NOT_PAY decision with a confidence score. The payment is injected as an outflow into the liquidity forecast and as a new unhedged payable position in the FX exposure analysis. Requires USDC payment via the x402 protocol (Circle Gateway) — see the 402 response for the payment flow. This is decision-support output, not an instruction to execute any transaction. All figures are computed deterministically (no LLM). Call get_example_input first if unsure of the shape.

fxExposure.description: Same shape as the /fx-exposure request body minus baseCurrency; positions is optional (the payment is auto-injected as a new unhedged payable position). fxRates must include the payment currency's rate if it differs from baseCurrency.

liquidity.description: Same shape as LiquidityRequest, minus baseCurrency (the payment is auto-injected as an additional cash flow outflow).

amount.description: Signed amount; positive is an inflow, negative is an outflow.

workingCapital.description: Optional standard accounting ratios (DSO/DPO/DIO/cash conversion cycle) computed from a balance snapshot and period flow — independent of the cashFlows-based daily projection above.

inventory.description: Optional inventory balance snapshot — enables days_inventory_outstanding and a full cash conversion cycle.

periodCOGS.description: Cost of goods sold / purchases over the reference period, in baseCurrency.

periodCreditSales.description: Credit sales over the reference period, in baseCurrency.

periodDays.description: Length of the reference period in days (e.g. 365 for a trailing year, 90 for a quarter).

date.description: Defaults to liquidity.startDate (or today) if omitted.

benchmarkReturns.description: Optional per-period benchmark series (same length as each `returns` series) to compute beta and correlation.

confidenceLevels.description: Confidence levels for VaR/Expected Shortfall. Supported: 0.9, 0.95, 0.975, 0.99, 0.995.

currencyExposure.description: Optional weight distribution by currency, for concentration analysis.

geographyExposure.description: Optional weight distribution by geography, for concentration analysis.

minimumAcceptableReturn.description: Per-period MAR used for downside deviation / Sortino ratio.

periodsPerYear.description: Periods per year in the return series (252 for daily equities, 365 for daily crypto).

returns.description: Per-period historical return series by symbol. All series must be the same length (≥2 observations).

sectorExposure.description: Optional weight distribution by sector, for concentration analysis.

stressScenarios.description: Optional stress scenarios. Shocks on the listed symbols propagate to unshocked symbols via covariance-based beta mapping (correlated impact), alongside the direct-only impact.

shocks.description: Fractional shock per symbol, e.g. -0.3 for a 30% drop.

weights.description: Portfolio weights by symbol. Must cover exactly the same symbols as `returns` and sum to 1.

name: treasury_decision
